title: Performance: Motion
text: Settings → Performance → Motion Quality preset Choose one of five cumulative quality tiers; Custom preserves individual choices. Enhanced visual effects Controls lighting, animation blending, replacement effects, and faster shadows. Individual choices are preserved while disabled. Smooth Motion Smooth small moving objects Attempt to smooth independently moving picture sprites whose visible area is up to 35x35 pixels and moves no more than 64 pixels between updates, such as coins. Requires Smooth Motion. Subpixel movement Keeps interpolated sprites at subpixel screen positions for smoother movement. This can cause shimmering on some artwork; turn it off to floor sprites to whole pixels. Character Animation Blending World Animation Blending Character Animation Blend Duration Set how much of the animation interval is spent blending frames. World Animation Blend Duration Set how much of the animation interval is spent blending frames. This blends between a character’s animation poses. It is separate from smoothing the character’s movement across the screen. If walking feels smooth but the character looks smeared during pose changes, shorten the character blend duration or disable this option while leaving Smooth Motion on.

title: Performance: Lighting & Effects
text: Settings → Performance → Lighting & Effects Quality preset Choose one of five cumulative quality tiers; Custom preserves individual choices. Enhanced visual effects Controls lighting, animation blending, replacement effects, and faster shadows. Individual choices are preserved while disabled. Lighting Effects Flame Light Flicker Flame Flicker Strength Light Strength Glow Strength Window Shadows Show the shadow or glow defined by the theme around floating windows and menus. Character Shadows Character Shadow Darkness Faster Character Shadows Uses one cheaper shadow pass, but may shade foreground artwork that should cover a shadow. Characters Receive Sun Shadows Shade characters in proportion to how much another character's projected shadow covers them. Mobile light-cone shadows (experimental) Let mobiles cast experimental soft cone shadows from nearby lights. Replacement Effects (experimental) Use procedural magic effects.

title: Performance: Caching
text: Settings → Performance → Caching Quality preset Choose one of five cumulative quality tiers; Custom preserves individual choices. Enhanced visual effects Controls lighting, animation blending, replacement effects, and faster shadows. Individual choices are preserved while disabled. Batch room artwork loading Load missing room artwork in one pause instead of spreading first-use work across frames. Sprite cache Choose how much artwork to keep ready. The reserve automatically scales with sprite resolution. Precache Sounds Uses roughly 300 MB more RAM to avoid first-play sound decoding delays. Show asset activity dots Show activity dots in the game view's lower-right: green for artwork decoding and processing, amber for audio decoding, and red for GPU artwork uploads. Potato GPU (4096px Limit) Use standalone textures instead of a large shared atlas for GPUs limited to 4096x4096 textures. Artwork resolution and upscaling are unchanged.

title: Performance: Power Saving
text: Settings → Performance → Power Saving Quality preset Choose one of five cumulative quality tiers; Custom preserves individual choices. Enhanced visual effects Controls lighting, animation blending, replacement effects, and faster shadows. Individual choices are preserved while disabled. Power save in background Reduce FPS when window is unfocused Always power save Limit FPS while focused. Power-save FPS VSync - Limit FPS Sync frame rate to the display. This applies the power-saving frame rate even while you are using the client. If the game seems capped below the rate you expected, check this before reducing graphics quality. Power save in background applies when the client loses focus; the two settings serve different situations.

title: Settings: Network
text: Settings → Network Enable NLSPT Enable Network Latency & Server Phase Timing, which learns the server frame phase and sends fresh input shortly before its next processing window. NLSPT safety (%) Minimum lead as a percentage of one server frame, with frame jitter added separately. Session-only; resets to 10% when goThoom starts. Edit Server List Add or remove server addresses used by the Login screen. This adjusts the safety margin for Network Latency & Server Phase Timing, not your internet connection speed. It is a session-only adjustment: it starts at 10% when the client launches and is not saved with your profile. Leave the default in place unless you are deliberately comparing timing behavior.

title: Arrange tiled windows
text: Settings → Display → Window Layout Combine chat + console Show chat and console output together in one pane. Auto-size side panels Automatically adjust side panel widths to use empty space beside the game. Drag either game divider to move the game sideways. Turn off to keep the current sizes and resize panels independently. Swap game side Choose Game on a side to move the game between the left and right edges. Swap inventory / players list Exchange the two lists without moving the game or messages. Combined messages on right Move the combined Chat and Console pane to the right side of the centered game. Messages above game Choose Messages above or below or Full-width message row to move the row above the game. Message split Turn off Combine chat + console to split the message area into separate panes. Extra width beside the playfield can become wider lists instead of empty space. With automatic sizing on, dragging either game divider slides the game sideways and moves both dividers together. Turn it off to keep the current sizes and resize each side independently. Turning it back on recalculates around the game’s current position.

title: Separate message panes
text: Settings → Display → Window Layout Combine chat + console Show chat and console output together in one pane. Auto-size side panels Automatically adjust side panel widths to use empty space beside the game. Drag either game divider to move the game sideways. Turn off to keep the current sizes and resize panels independently. Swap game side Choose Game on a side to move the game between the left and right edges. Swap inventory / players list Exchange the two lists without moving the game or messages. Swap console and chat Exchange Console and Chat within their row, stack, or separate areas. Messages above game Move the message row above the game. List and message order stay the same. Message split Place separate Chat and Console beside each other or stack them in their shared area. Drag the divider to resize them. Side by side gives each message pane more height but shorter lines; Stacked gives longer lines but less visible history in each pane. This choice applies when Chat and Console share one message area. It is unavailable when they are combined, or when the layout already puts them in separate areas, such as above and below the game.

title: Add a character
text: Login → Add Character Character Password (optional) Remember Password Keep settings separate Start this character with independent windows, appearance, audio, notifications, and related settings. Add Cancel You can add the character without entering a password here. When you later press Connect, the client asks for it if no password is available for that login. Adding a character only creates a local login entry; it does not create a Clan Lord account. Use a character profile for preferences such as window positions and tiled layout, UI scale and themes, text sizes, status bars, speech bubbles, graphics effects, audio levels, TTS voice, and notifications. The first profile copies your current shared setup. Turning this off returns to shared settings without deleting the profile. Server addresses and file locations remain shared; script and macro enablement have their own Player/All choices.

title: Create a hotkey
text: Actions → Hotkeys → + Record Capture a key/mouse combo Name Command Add another command line Add another command line OK Cancel The selected player is resolved when you press the hotkey, not when you save it. This example can therefore inspect any player you select, using the same binding each time. It needs a selection in Players; the player beneath the pointer is a different context value.

title: Create a text shortcut
text: Actions → Shortcuts → Add For All Shortcut Expansion OK Cancel Shortcuts expand the first word when you send a line. With this example, “pp hello” becomes “/ponder hello”; “hello pp” is not expanded. Choose a short word you are unlikely to start an ordinary message with by accident.

title: Review a script
text: Actions → Scripts → Info Open File Open Folder Copy Error Validate Permissions Reload Stop Close A reload can fail while the previous working copy continues running. Read the status and error before assuming your edited code is active. Validate can help find source problems; if the change requests additional access, review Permissions before trying again.

title: Grant script permissions
text: Actions → Scripts → Info → Permissions Register commands and shortcuts Add slash commands and text shortcuts to the client. Bind keys and mouse buttons React to bound keys or mouse buttons, inspect their input event and consume that input. Send server commands Send text and commands to the server as your character, including equipment commands. Game data and events Read players, inventory, selections, vitals, scenery and world updates. Chat and server messages Read chat and server messages, including private messages. Automatic movement Steer your character using the movement mouse. Windows, toolbars and overlays Create client windows, toolbar buttons and world overlays. Input box and pointer Read or replace unsent input text and inspect the pointer. Notifications and sound Show notifications and play sounds. Persistent script storage Read and write this script's private saved data, shared across characters. Background timers Run repeating callbacks without a command or hotkey. Session events React to login, logout, character changes and script stop events. Grant Block all Yes Boats sends a whisper as your character when it recognizes a boat offer addressed to you. This permission allows that reply; reading the offer and checking your character’s name require separate chat and game-data grants. Grant saves only the checked capabilities, and the decision applies to this script across characters. Unchecking something does not automatically adapt the script: a feature that depends on the denied capability may no longer work. Reopen Info → Permissions to change your decision; Block all also disables the script.
